![banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_HEADER.png) [![Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/D1D8LKA5N) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/869218732650688543?color=3e72b3&label=DISCORD&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.com/invite/S5nffJbuvA) [![CurseForge 專案](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-projects-3e72b3?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/finndog_123/projects) [![Modrinth 專案](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-projects-3e72b3?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/user/FinnDog_123) [![查看結構](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/c110cc09347a4f9f9de6c974f2fa35d8.png)](https://previews.moogsmods.com/voyager-structures/1.21.1/) ![Overview](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_BANNER1.png) 此模組支援 Forge、Fabric、NeoForge 與 Quilt！也可僅限伺服器端安裝。Forge 的支援已在 1.20.4 版本後停止。 ### 關於 Moogs Voyager Structures 透過充滿動態與趣味的新結構，徹底改變您的 Minecraft 體驗。這些結構完全使用原版方塊與實體打造，能無縫融入遊戲中，提供令人興奮的戰利品、具挑戰性的敵人以及友善的村民。此模組相容於任何整合包，在保留經典 Minecraft 氛圍的同時豐富您的世界。加入 Moogs Voyager Structures，展開一場冒險與發現之旅吧！ [![3D 即時瀏覽所有結構](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/f8fe835413394a76b10a678afefea30f.png)](https://previews.moogsmods.com/voyager-structures/1.21.1/) ### 設定套件 模組的每個面向均可透過資料包 (Datapack) 進行自訂。完整說明與範本可[在此處](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/mvs-moogs-voyager-structure-config-pack)找到。 ![features](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_BANNER2.png) ![collage](https://i.imgur.com/epC7vBE.png) ![showcase](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_BANNER4.png) ### 影片
### 整合包 查看所有整合包請[點擊此處](https://www.modpackindex.com/modpack/finder?included_mods=37802)。 ![banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_BANNER3.png) 獲得回覆最快且最有效的方式是加入我們的 [Discord 伺服器](https://discord.gg/S5nffJbuvA)。 [![BHsponser](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_PROMO.png)](https://bisecthosting.com/moogsmods?r=cfmvs)
